newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FARMERS BLOCK GERMAN BORDER CROSSING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FARMERS BLOCK GERMAN BORDER CROSSING.

text.p: A group of Polish farmers in the Solidarity trade union blocked a road at a German border crossing for two hours on Tuesday to protest against food imports, PAP news agency reported.
The blockade was staged between 11.00 and 13.00 local time near border crossing at Jedrzychowice, southwest Poland, but caused no traffic disruption because the police organised detours, PAP said.

"We are protesting against the farming policy of the government. Our demands of limiting duty-free imports of grain, livestock, poultry, rapeseed and potatoes are neglected," PAP quoted the Farmers' Solidarity local chief, Marian Zagorny, as saying.

Zagorny said his union would step up protest and stage blockade at other crossings. "At those times, we will have food and sleeping bags and our protests will be indefinite," PAP quoted his as saying.
Agricuture Minister Jaroslaw Kalinowski said on Tuesday he would visit the region of Jelenia Gora, where the farmers' protest erupted, to hold talks with the unionists.

Poland's outmoded agriculture is uncompetitive in many areas. The government of ex-communists and a peasant party is often divided on whether to protect the domestic producers and let food prices grow or treat curbing inflation as priority.
